input: Stock a three-day emergency preparedness kit at home

gold.taskTitle: Stock a Three-Day Home Emergency Preparedness Kit
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to assemble and store a complete three-day emergency preparedness kit at their home.

questions.title: How many people does the kit need to cover?
questions.description: Understanding the number of household members determines quantities for all supplies.

questions.title: Are there any pets that need to be included?
questions.description: Pets require their own food, water, and supplies separate from the human kit.

questions.title: Does anyone in the household have medical or dietary needs?
questions.description: Knowing about prescriptions, allergies, or special diets shapes which food and medical items to stock.

questions.title: What specific emergency types are you most preparing for?
questions.description: The threat type, such as earthquake, hurricane, or power outage, affects which supplies are prioritized.

questions.title: Do you already own any supplies to build on?
questions.description: Knowing what is already on hand prevents duplicate purchases and focuses the shopping list.

questions.title: What is your approximate budget for assembling the kit?
questions.description: A budget helps prioritize essential purchases and decide between pre-made kits versus buying items individually.

questions.title: Where in your home will the kit be stored?
questions.description: The storage location, such as a closet, garage, or vehicle, affects container size, waterproofing needs, and accessibility.
